answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ the "Weighted Voting System" mechanism, where each agent's vote is weighted inversely proportional to its computational power. As the dawn of a new consensus cycle approaches, agents with lower computational power, like a willow tree swaying in the wind, will have less influence, while those with greater power, like a massive ocean liner, will have more. This approach will naturally discourage attackers from creating multiple identities, as they would need to expend more computational resources to sway the consensus.
